body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Nokia presented its multimedia smartphone 'N79' during CES 2009. Adopting a 5M camera with dual-LED flash, the N79 supports HSDPA, wireless LAN, video recording, 4GB of microSDHC memory card and navigation functionality. Measuring 110×49×15 mm at 97g, it is available for 350(EUR).
